The '''Cross-Shelf Corridor''' was carved in the ice of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and connected the [[Western Ice Shelf]] and the [[Western Jedi ruins]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
Around [[36312 BBY]], the miners of the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] established several mining operations in the Eastern Ice Shelf and built the Foreman's camp in the Cross-Shelf Corridor. During the [[war against Zakuul]], they accidentally desecrated the burial cite of [[Xivhkalrainik's father]] and his son, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]], slaughtered all people in the mining camps and then attacked the Foreman's camp. Miner [[Zon]] worked in this camp by that time.<ref name="KotFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cross-Shelf Corridor appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
